Rationale: tenant customer_theme_mode overrides next-themes resolvedTheme, which in 0.3.0 ignores forcedTheme and can be a stale dark
Hex to HSL colour-variant generation (hover, light, dark, foreground, glow, shadow)
Google Maps Places API singleton loader shared across components
FAQ navigation link gating on the existence of active FAQs
Tenant CMS page content loading with global fallback
Rationale: never fall back to another tenant's CMS content — tenant-specific first, then global (tenant_id IS NULL) only
Gotcha: on localhost draft CMS pages are fetched too; production requires status='published'
Hard-coded per-page default marketing content used when the CMS has nothing
Default privacy-policy SMS/A2P consent copy (STOP/HELP, no third-party sharing)
Three-tier site settings resolution: CMS overrides then tenant row then defaults
Rationale: immediate tenant-derived settings prevent a flash of default Drive247 branding while the CMS query runs
Tenant working hours and live open/closed status
Rationale: a calendar date's day-of-week must NOT be timezone-converted; only 'open now' and time validation are timezone-aware
Overnight opening window handling — a close earlier than open spans midnight
Calendar date-picker gating against enabled working days
Pickup/dropoff time validation against the tenant's business hours
SSR-safe Supabase browser client with no-op storage on the server
Rationale: untyped Supabase client escape hatch for columns absent from the generated Database types
Gotcha: Supabase URL and anon key fall back to hardcoded production values when env vars are missing
Render-time injection of mileage, T&C and Bonzah clauses into stored agreement templates
Rationale: inject at render time rather than rewriting the operator-owned stored template row
Rationale: injection is conditional on the operator's own configured data, so no clause is forced on anyone
Rationale: splice above the EARLIEST signature marker in the document, not the first matching pattern
Rationale: splice at block boundaries — mid-paragraph insertion makes the PDF block parser emit literal BLOCK_18 markers
Rationale: also detect the legacy {{vehicle_allowed_mileage}} placeholder so mileage is not stated twice in two formats
Coupling: agreement-injection is byte-identical in portal, booking and the Deno edge function and must be changed in all three
Canonical mileage allowance and excess-rate resolution for rental agreements
Rationale: unconfigured mileage renders 'Not specified', never 'Unlimited' — otherwise a missing field contractually grants unlimited mileage
Rationale: mileage tier selection must mirror pricing's rate-gated tier choice, not day count alone
Rationale: the excess rate is a money term in a signed contract, so currency code and distance unit come from tenant settings
Coupling: agreement-mileage duplicated byte-for-byte across portal, booking and edge functions with a diff gate in CI notes
Open-ended (PAYG/rolling) rentals state a recurring per-period allowance instead of a total
Tenant CMS Terms and Conditions incorporated into the rental agreement
Rationale: the terms fetch deliberately ignores status='published' because every section save resets the page to draft and would silently drop the terms
Rationale: tenant terms APPEND to the built-in boilerplate (insurance, liability, governing law) rather than replacing it
Rationale: presentational metadata keys are skipped so a title-only section does not render as a Terms heading with the page title as its body
Defence-in-depth stripping of script/style/on* markup before CMS text is embedded in a contract
Rationale: the T&C fetch never throws — a CMS hiccup must not block an agreement from being sent
Plain-text terms rendering for tenants with no stored HTML agreement template
Coupling: agreement-terms duplicated byte-for-byte across portal, booking and edge functions
Bonzah insurer-supplied rental-agreement insurance addendum (ten verbatim clauses)
Rationale: insurer-supplied compliance text is hardcoded, not tenant-editable CMS content, so a v3 update propagates from one file
Rationale: the addendum is a tenant-level referral disclosure gated on integration_bonzah, never on whether this renter bought coverage
Rationale: ASCII-only punctuation because the booking engine's htmlToText() replaces non-Latin-1 characters with spaces
Rationale: flat h2/p sequence with no wrapper div — the portal PDF block parser would flatten a div's contents into raw text
Bonzah renter-facing insurance disclosure text and canonical partner links
Rationale: per-product flyers link the insurer's canonical URLs instead of self-hosted mirrors that go stale on revision
Rationale: consumer Terms of Service points at business.bonzah.com/terms, superseding the older link in the source compliance .docx
Rationale: businessPartnerTerms is operator-facing and must never appear in the renter disclosure
Bonzah policy start-date clamp — the earliest insurable night begins Pacific tomorrow
Rationale: GoNiko Jul 2026 — a same-day +1 extension charged $26.95 with no policy behind it, so every UI must mirror the clamp
Rationale: Pacific-tomorrow uses calendar-part arithmetic rather than now+24h because of the 25-hour DST fall-back day
Coupling: this client-side clamp mirrors the server clamp and end-exclusive splitDateRange inside the bonzah-create-quote edge function
CDW + RCLI rendered as one bundle entry — display-only, coverage_types storage unchanged
Dynamic rental pricing with weekend and holiday surcharges across all tiers
Rationale: every tier runs the same per-day loop on its per-day equivalent rate so weekly/monthly discounts survive surcharging
Turo-style operator-set per-day price that overrides tier rate and every surcharge
Additive surcharge stacking mode — all applicable surcharges sum instead of highest-priority-wins
Rationale: auto-extend 'set price' rentals skip surcharges and manual day prices because the operator advertises a flat rate
Rationale: Number() coercion because PostgREST returns Postgres numeric columns as JSON strings that would corrupt totals via string concatenation
Rationale: parseDateString exists because Safari does not reliably parse new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')
Coupling: byte-identical twin in apps/portal — divergence makes customer and staff prices silently disagree
Rental extras total with per_trip versus per_day billing
Rationale: billing_type (how often it is charged) is orthogonal to pricing_type (where the unit price comes from)
Coupling: byte-identical twin in apps/portal — divergence makes the customer total and the operator total disagree
Date-only column parsing as local midnight
Rationale: new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') parses as UTC midnight and renders/compares a day early in negative-offset timezones
Rationale: must NOT be used for timestamptz columns, which carry a real instant and keep new Date()
AI insurance-document verification: type recognition, field extraction, business rules, validity assessment
Gotcha: PDF uploads are never actually read — the model is asked to infer the document type from the filename and give a conservative assessment
Filename-keyword and phrase heuristic fallback when the model returns non-JSON prose
Business rule: minimum liability coverage of $25,000/$50,000/$25,000 for a customer-supplied policy
OpenRouter free-tier model (mistral-7b-instruct) used for verification, with pending_review as the failure mode
Client-side audit logging with field-level before/after diff
Gotcha: IP address and user agent are not captured here — noted as a server-side concern for production
